text: おこると　どくガス　はくけど…　ふだんは　いいこ　なのよ

structure.jp: どくガス　はくけど…

structure.en: it's a good kid, you know

patterns.name: 〜と (when/if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever that happens, the next thing follows. おこると = 'when it gets angry'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two halves with 'but'. はくけど = 'it spews it, but'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: なの after a noun gives a soft, explaining tone, and なのよ sounds feminine. いいこ なのよ = 'it's a good kid, you see'.
